All other characters (spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged. This completely transforms all keyword signatures and numeric values, preventing simple filter matches while remaining extremely easy for the language model to process deterministically.

4. If the character is any other symbol (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
